dmz.quest.void_training_1.name: Stillness in the Void
dmz.quest.void_training_1.desc: Tsukisora only. Defeat five Raditz-class enemies without Ki Control. This is the first step toward earning Ki Control and unlocking Voidstone Ascension.
dmz.quest.void_training_2.name: Pressure Without Power
dmz.quest.void_training_2.desc: Tsukisora only. Defeat six Vegeta-class enemies. Complete this trial to continue toward Ki Control.
dmz.quest.void_training_3.name: The Unbroken Will
dmz.quest.void_training_3.desc: Tsukisora only. Defeat Frieza, whose strength dwarfs the previous trials. Complete this trial to continue toward Ki Control.
dmz.quest.void_training_4.name: At the Edge of the Horizon
dmz.quest.void_training_4.desc: Tsukisora only. Defeat seven Cell-class enemies in a test of endurance. Complete this trial to reach the final test.
dmz.quest.void_training_5.name: The Void Master — Ki Control
dmz.quest.void_training_5.desc: Tsukisora only. Defeat eight Buu-class enemies, then defeat the final Buu. Completing this final Void Training trial grants Ki Control and unlocks Voidstone Ascension.
dmz.quest.void_ascension_1.name: Trial of the Abyss — Void Awakening
dmz.quest.void_ascension_1.desc: Tsukisora only. You cannot begin until all five Void Training quests are complete. Defeat three Raditz-class enemies and then the trial boss to unlock Void Awakening (void_awakening).
dmz.quest.void_ascension_2.name: Trial of the Ascendant — Void Ascendant
dmz.quest.void_ascension_2.desc: Tsukisora only. Complete the previous Ascension trial, defeat three Vegeta-class enemies and then the trial boss to unlock Void Ascendant (void_ascendant).
dmz.quest.void_ascension_3.name: Trial of Event Horizon — Event Horizon
dmz.quest.void_ascension_3.desc: Tsukisora only. Complete the previous Ascension trial, defeat four Frieza-class enemies and then the trial boss to unlock Event Horizon (event_horizon).
dmz.quest.void_ascension_4.name: Trial of Eternal Void — Eternal Void
dmz.quest.void_ascension_4.desc: Tsukisora only. Complete the previous Ascension trial, defeat four Cell-class enemies and then the trial boss to unlock Eternal Void (eternal_void).
dmz.quest.void_ascension_5.name: Trial of the Voidstone Abyss — Voidstone Abyss
dmz.quest.void_ascension_5.desc: Tsukisora only. Complete the previous Ascension trial, defeat four Buu-class enemies and then the final Buu to unlock Voidstone Abyss (voidstone_abyss), the final Void manifestation.
dmz_voidstone.story.ki_control_locked: Tsukisora must complete the Void Training saga before receiving Ki Control.
